shared_elements: low-relief figure(s) rendered in profile outline
curving incised contour lines defining a body
justification: The only correspondence is the most generic one: both surfaces carry shallow relief figures whose bodies are defined by continuous curving contour lines seen in profile. A shows a single ambiguous animal-like form isolated on an irregular field, while B shows an ordered procession of repeated human figures with elaborate headdresses, beards, robes and held objects, arranged in stacked registers above a rosette-and-pattern border — no shared motif, relationship or arrangement.
